title: Justly Juicy Canadian Beans Casserole
description: A sweet and silky Canadian dish featuring baked beans, perfect for a sick day, pescatarian-friendly and made with a papillote cooking method.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Place the cod fillets in a large piece of aluminum foil or parchment paper, leaving space in the center for the beans.
Drizzle the lemon juice and olive oil over the cod fillets.
Spoon the baked beans over the cod fillets, leaving a small border around the edges.
Sprinkle the sugar and spice mixture evenly over the beans.
Fold the foil or parchment paper over the beans and cod, creating a papillote.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the papillote from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
